Location: Zaltbommel, Netherlands (Candidates based in or near Zaltbommel preferred) Employment Type: Full-Time (FTE) Start Date: ASAP Language Requirement: Fluent Dutch and English (Mandatory)
About the Role
We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused IT Onsite Support Engineer to join our team in Zaltbommel. You will provide hands-on technical support to end users, ensuring IT systems, devices, and workplace technology operate efficiently. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced IT professional who enjoys working directly with users in a fast-paced onsite environment.
Key Responsibilities
-
Provide 1st and 2nd line onsite IT support for end users.
-
Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network-related issues.
-
Install, configure, and support desktops, laptops, printers, mobile devices, and peripherals.
-
Deploy, image, and configure Windows devices.
-
Support Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, and Office applications.
-
Manage user accounts, permissions, and passwords using Active Directory or Microsoft Entra ID.
-
Log, track, and resolve incidents and service requests using an ITSM/ticketing system.
-
Perform hardware replacements and asset management.
-
Escalate complex technical issues to appropriate support teams.
-
Deliver excellent customer service while meeting SLA targets.
-
Document troubleshooting steps and maintain accurate support records.
Required Skills & Experience
-
Minimum 2 years of IT support experience in a desktop or onsite support role.
-
Strong knowledge of:
-
Windows 10/11
-
Microsoft 365
-
Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID
-
Basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP)
-
Hardware troubleshooting and device deployment
-
Experience working with ticketing systems (ServiceNow, TOPdesk, Jira, or similar).
-
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
-
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
-
Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks...

Your responsibilities
- Review of changes in contract management system by Customer Services Coordinators.
- Timely invoicing of sales orders of assigned customers/regions.
- Flag deviations from company billing matrix to reduce & control exceptions in billing process.
- Investigate & follow up of customer queries/complaints about invoices.
- Work closely with the commercial & the credit & collections team.
- Act as an advisor for all Billing / Order to Cash activities.
- Open to work on continuous improvements in billing process.
- Prepare ad hoc overviews on billing for commercial teams and/or group finance.
- Ensure proper filing of customer communication & correspondence for audit purposes

What do you bring?
- Team player and comfortable in a multicultural and international environment.
- Must possess and demonstrate a high degree of integrity.
- Commitment to continuous improvement.
- Strong communication, analytical and organization skills.
- Experience with establishing and maintaining effective work relationships.
- Ability to effectively cope with change and multi-task.
- Must be organized, detail oriented and able to efficiently function under pressure and produce detailed, error-free work within limited timeframes.
What you also bring
- MBO degree in accounting or business.
- Minimum +2 years working in a similar position.
- Experience of Microsoft Dynamics 365 is an asset.
- Skilled in Microsoft Office with advanced Excel skills.
- Good command of the English language, both written and spoken.
